properties.description:
Implemented the accepted shared Repositories composition in the workspace and Review Changes. Repository folders contain checks under their declaring files, component sources, model declarations and systems under their package files. Shared filtering and saved queries replace separate Files, Checks, Data models, UI components and Systems navigation. The detail selector offers Code, Check details (Results/Code), UI editor (Visual/Code/Preview), contributor Node editor and dependency graphs according to the selected item. Review supplies its source revision and defaults to changed:true. Expand one level, expand/collapse all, context actions, source editing, guarded drafts, retained selections and latest check results remain available. Folder double-click expansion and refresh after an agent completes edits were also verified.

Removed the former standalone model/system views and component-gallery host route/declarations. The composition consumes contributor-owned provenance and schemas. Historical scopes read captured sources only; snapshots that did not capture model/system/component metadata or check results explicitly report that absence rather than showing live data as historical evidence.

Validation: final build and mandatory type-safety/organisation checks passed, with 952 authored sources and zero violations (.harness/repositories-final-build.log). All 22 model tests passed. Focused model/system/component/shared-tree and Review tests passed; 23 final UI regression tests passed (.harness/repositories-final-regressions.log), including filtering/saved queries, folder expansion, pane persistence and source editing. Three-repository check execution and retained-source/draft checks passed (.harness/repositories-check-execution.log); the complete agent-edit, human-edit, checks, acceptance and commit flow passed (.harness/repositories-end-to-end.log). Screenshots were inspected under Systems/Depth3/HarnessApp/test-results-repositories-complete-verified and test-results-repositories-final-regressions.

The full checkpoint is not entirely green: 230/234 Harness runtime tests passed, with the same planning-state-history, range-placement and two review-placement failures outside this change (.harness/repositories-complete-checkpoint.log). The full browser run initially passed 191/207; affected composition/test-navigation issues were corrected and passed focused reruns. Seven failures outside this scope remain recorded: feedback-hidden, multi-pane-splitter mini layout, planning-save-pending, planning-viewport, review-queue, ui-seven placement, and workflow export (.harness/repositories-complete-browser-checkpoint.log). Human visual acceptance remains with the parent review.
properties.title: Unify repository navigation and detail views across workspace and Review
